name: health-evidence-companion
description: General adult health explanations, medicine information and evidence navigation with current primary sources.

interface.longDescription: Understand adult health questions, common symptoms, medicine ingredients and mechanisms, interaction evidence, medical research and psychiatric medicine information. Navigate primary sources in Serbia, Russia and internationally, and learn how to structure a separate private archive using blank templates. Answers follow your language. This skills-only package has no required local server or paid medical API. It provides general information and clinician questions, not definitive diagnoses, prescriptions, treatment changes or personal record management. It does not solicit or process PHI. Stored notes and source reading limits are explicit; current guidance must be checked when relevant.
defaultPrompt: Explain what doctors consider when an adult cough persists.
How do SSRIs and NSAIDs interact?
What does research say about zinc for colds?

publication.release_notes: Initial English edition with six informational skills, primary-source references and blank templates.
